paper_title: MADLLM Multivariate Anomaly Detection via Pre-trained LLMs
caption: : F1 score results
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates F1 score results (in percent) for three MADLLM model variants across five datasets, showing grouped performance values per dataset. The horizontal axis contains the categorical dataset labels, ordered left to right as SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, and MSL, with no explicit axis label shown. The vertical axis is labeled “F1 Score (%)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 80 to 100, with major tick labels at 80, 90, and 100. Each dataset category contains a cluster of three adjacent bars corresponding to the legend at the top: MADLLM (light green), MADLLM w/o feature embedding (light purple), and MADLLM w/o skip embedding (light peach). For SMD, the bars are approximately 93–94% (green), about 90% (purple), and about 90% (peach). For PSM, the bars are approximately 97–98% (green), about 94% (purple), and about 93% (peach). For SWaT, the bars are about 91% (green), about 86% (purple), and about 86% (peach). For SMAP, the bars are about 93–94% (green), about 90% (purple), and about 90% (peach). For MSL, the bars are about 92–93% (green), about 89–90% (purple), and about 89% (peach). The bars are presented as side-by-side groups (not stacked), with uniform styling and no visible special emphasis such as annotations or highlighting, and the categories do not appear to be sorted by value.
